newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Unibank to upgrade Danish 96 GDP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Unibank to upgrade Danish 96 GDP.

text.p: Denmark's Unibank said on Wednesday second-quarter 1996 Danish GDP growth as reported by the National Statistics office was so strong that the bank would upgrade its own forecast.
Official data published on Monday showed second-quarter 1996 growth of 1.0 percent, compared with 0.6 percent in the first quarter and -0.4 percent in the second quarter of 1995.

Unibank Markets Chief Economist Ellen Ploeger told Reuters other estimates placed the growth rate still higher, and the bank would revise its current full-year forecast of 0.75 percent. But she did not say by how much the bank would revise its forecast.
"It is clear that development in the general economic indicators points in the direction of an upward adjustment of our prognosis," Ploeger said.
